agent_explanation: Thin-wall (w=0.1) high-speed (~39 m/s) impact gains energy: incoming |vx|=38.89 at step 6 rebounds to |vx|=41.33 at step 7 despite e=0.913, so speed 38.90->41.34 and energy 814->911.9 exceeds allowance. Likely impulse/positional-correction error on thin box (e.g. double-counted contact or excessive depenetration adding normal velocity) rather than e-scaled reflection.
